purpose: Collect consent-based newsletter signups and send a confirmation message.
source_template: Gravity Forms newsletter signup pattern, adapted for LightSpeed defaults

confirmations.name: Default confirmation
confirmations.message: Thanks. Please check your inbox for the next step.

spam_settings.turnstile: use only if add-on and keys are confirmed

embedding_target: Newsletter section or signup page using Gravity Forms block
data_retention_notes: Retain only data needed for consent evidence and newsletter operations. Confirm retention with client policy.
required_addons: Email marketing add-on only if list sync is required
risks: List feed availability and consent wording must be confirmed before live sync
